name: Rebalanced Margarita
desc: A margarita with equal tequila and lime plus agave, built in parts so it scales to a pitcher.

source.title: Classic Margarita with Tequila & Grand Marnier
source.evidence: Same idea of equal tequila and lime with Grand Marnier plus a separate sweetener, batched by the pitcher; that version uses simple syrup and no Cointreau.

ingredients.raw: 1 lime wedge, for the rim and garnish
1 tbsp kosher salt or Tajin, for the rim (optional)

steps: Pick a part size: 1/2 oz per part makes one drink (1 1/2 oz tequila), and 1/2 cup per part makes a pitcher of about 8.
Prep the glass: if salting the rim, spread the salt on a small plate, run the lime wedge around the rim of a rocks glass, then dip it in the salt. Fill the glass with ice.
Add the tequila, Cointreau, Grand Marnier, lime juice and agave to a cocktail shaker filled with ice.
Shake hard until well chilled, about 15 seconds.
Strain into the prepared glass over the ice. Garnish with the lime wedge and serve right away.
tips: For a pitcher, stir the mix with a couple of cups of ice for a full minute before pouring so it gets the dilution a shaker would give.

references.title: Classic Margarita with Tequila & Grand Marnier
references.usedFor: pitcher batching, salt rim over ice
